description: Tournierjc TensorFold fork 53ceb126 with the exact turboderp EXL3 4.05bpw checkpoint declared by the kit. The published vision sidecar is converted once by the pinned engine into the managed cache; atomic conversion output is reused on restart. Three streams at the native 262,144-token window follow the kit sample. INT8 KV, MTP and the creator’s EXL3 kernels. Memory is an estimate, not a measured qualification; physical Spark execution remains untested here.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next EXL3 4.05bpw TensorFold single Spark (tournierjc)
